instruction: Determine which student scored the most and apply a color to their marks cell.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the highest scoring student and highlighting their marks cell. Custom getter dynamically scans all marks in column E to find the maximum value and identifies which cells are highlighted. Custom metric verifies that at least one highlighted cell contains the maximum mark value, ensuring both requirements are met: (1) identifying the student with highest marks, and (2) highlighting their marks cell.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: (1) dynamically identifies cells with maximum marks value in column E (lines 74-78 of getter), and (2) verifies that at least one highlighted cell contains the maximum marks (lines 30-32 of metric).

Correct semantic logic: Getter scans all marks in column E dynamically (lines 48-60), computes max_mark and max_mark_cells, identifies highlighted cells by fill color (lines 63-71). Metric correctly checks if intersection of highlighted_cells and max_mark_cells is non-empty.

Proper edge case handling: Logic handles multiple cells with same max mark (any one being highlighted will pass), non-numeric values are skipped gracefully (try/except lines 54-60), white/transparent fills are excluded appropriately.

Correct data flow: Getter extracts the right state (marks values + highlighting status) -> Metric compares the right aspects (highlighted cells contain max value) -> Expected is empty rules dict which is correct since all verification logic is self-contained.
